process_image_with_deepseek_ocr_processo: process an image and text prompt with DeepseekOCRProcessor to get tokenized input and pixel values
tokenize_text_with_images: tokenize a conversation string with image tokens and split images into tiles for the model
apply_dynamic_image_preprocessing: apply dynamic preprocessing to split an image into multiple crops based on aspect ratio and tile count
configure_deepseek_ocr_model: configure a DeepseekVLV2Config with vision, projector, and language sub-configs for the OCR model
run_ngram_no_repeat_logit_processor: run the n-gram no repeat logit processor to prevent token repetition during OCR generation
